values.note: Free, first come; no reservations at Kansas state fishing lakes. Seven consecutive days at a state fishing lake, then five days away (K.A.R. 115-8-9(c), amended 2023); a longer stay needs a written KDWP permit.

note: KDWP state fishing lake west of Tonganoxie in a 341-acre, mostly timbered wildlife area. Primitive camping in designated areas only, fires in the metal rings; two open shelter houses can be reserved through the area manager. Carry out your trash. Boats for fishing and hunting only; no alcohol, horses, off-road vehicles or target shooting; the south half of the lake is a refuge. Dam work is finished and the lake was refilling in 2026. --Claude
